rescue-task-interaction.definition:
# /etc/systemd/system/rescue-task-interaction.service
[Unit]
Description=Rescue local interaction and fixed-camera observation
RequiresMountsFor=/root/rescue/system_20261010/ros2_ws
After=local-fs.target rescue-mipi-vision.service
PartOf=rescue-standalone.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/rescue/system_20261010/ros2_ws
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=ROS_LOG_DIR=/root/rescue/system_20261010/ros2_ws/logs/ros
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/default/rescue-standalone
ExecStart=/bin/bash /root/rescue/system_20261010/ros2_ws/tools/run_standalone_tasks.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
KillMode=control-group
KillSignal=SIGINT
TimeoutStopSec=20

rescue-presentation.definition:
# /etc/systemd/system/rescue-presentation.service
[Unit]
Description=Rescue robot live control dashboard
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/rescue/system_20261010/ros2_ws
ExecStart=/usr/bin/bash /root/rescue/system_20261010/ros2_ws/tools/run_presentation.sh --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 8090
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStopSec=8

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
